introTitle: Secure, clean and reliable power, engineered to perform.
intro: Donmac Energy designs, supplies, installs, commissions and maintains solar and energy-storage systems for businesses, institutions, mines and rural communities. From rooftop arrays to hybrid back-up systems and community mini-grids, every system is sized from measured loads, built with Tier-1 equipment and handed over with full documentation.
introPoints: Tier-1 modules, hybrid inverters and LiFePO4 storage
NCC Grade 4 Category E electrical contractor
Manufacturer warranties of up to 5 years on equipment

services.title: Solar EPC
services.summary: Turnkey engineering, procurement and construction of solar PV plants, with one accountable team from site survey to certified handover.

services.title: Commercial and industrial solar PV
services.summary: Rooftop and ground-mount systems that cut daytime grid and diesel costs for offices, hotels, factories and campuses.

services.title: Utility-scale solar development and EPC
services.summary: Development support and EPC delivery for large ground-mounted plants, drawing on the Group's engineering, procurement and project-governance backbone.
services.alt: Rows of solar modules on a large array

services.title: Battery energy storage systems
services.summary: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) storage that shifts solar into the evening, rides through outages and reduces peak demand.

services.title: Hybrid solar and backup power
services.summary: Hybrid inverter systems that combine solar, batteries, grid and generators so critical loads never go dark.

services.title: Solar water pumping
services.summary: Solar-driven borehole and surface pumps for irrigation, livestock and community water supply, with no fuel to buy.

services.title: Rural electrification and mini-grids
services.summary: Solar systems and mini-grids for health posts, schools, civic centres and communities beyond the reach of the grid.

services.title: Power distribution and electrical infrastructure
services.summary: LV distribution, protection and earthing that make energy systems safe, compliant and reliable.

services.title: Operations, maintenance and remote monitoring
services.summary: Preventive and corrective maintenance with remote monitoring, so systems keep delivering the yield they were designed for.
services.alt: Engineer commissioning inverters and battery systems

services.title: Energy feasibility studies and technical consulting
services.summary: Independent load analysis, system options and financial modelling that turn an energy problem into a bankable project.
